verdict.rationale: Rendering strategy is a fair question for a UI framework, so the axis applies. React Compiler (react-docs-15) only automates memoization at build time, replacing manual useMemo, useCallback and React.memo; it is not described as removing a diffing step. Community discussion (react-comm-5, react-comm-6) instead describes React's own DOM abstraction with change management and scheduled updates, so nothing shows React updating the DOM without virtual DOM diffing.
